title: Implement ORM models for DermAtlas
description:
Create all SQLAlchemy async ORM models required for the TDD test suite to pass. These are foundational — all endpoint implementations depend on them.

Models to create (each in app/models/<name>.py):

- app/models/user.py
  User(user_id PK, email UNIQUE, password_hash, full_name, role ENUM[PCP,PATIENT], npi_number nullable, created_at)

- app/models/patient.py
  Patient(patient_id PK, primary_physician_id FK→User, mrn_internal, date_of_birth, gender, created_at)

- app/models/clinical_image.py
  ClinicalImage(query_id UUID PK, user_id FK→User, patient_id FK→Patient, gcs_image_uri, vertex_vector_id, lesion_location, clinician_notes nullable, captured_at)

- app/models/reference_atlas.py
  ReferenceAtlas(reference_id UUID PK, gcs_image_uri, vertex_vector_id, diagnosis_label, diagnosis_type, modality, body_part, source_dataset)

- app/models/recommendation_feedback.py
  RecommendationFeedback(feedback_id PK, query_id FK→ClinicalImage, reference_id FK→ReferenceAtlas, user_id FK→User, is_helpful BOOL, feedback_timestamp)
  Unique constraint on (query_id, reference_id, user_id) for upsert semantics.

- app/models/audit_log.py
  AuditLog(log_id PK, user_id FK→User, action STR, target_resource STR, timestamp)

Also create app/models/__init__.py that imports all models (so Base.metadata is populated).

All models must inherit from app.db.base.Base.
Use SQLite-compatible column types (no Postgres-specific types) so aiosqlite tests work.
For UUID PKs use String(36) with default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()) for SQLite compat.

Verify: ENV=testing pytest --co -q shows 85 tests; conftest engine fixture no longer errors.

title: Implement app/core/auth.py JWT and password utilities
description:
Create app/core/auth.py with the auth utility functions required by conftest.py fixtures and auth endpoint tests.

Functions needed:

  get_password_hash(plain: str) -> str
    - Use passlib CryptContext with bcrypt scheme

  verify_password(plain: str, hashed: str) -> bool
    - Returns True if plain matches hashed

  create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta_seconds: int | None = None) -> str
    - Signs a JWT using python-jose
    - Reads SECRET_KEY and ALGORITHM from settings (add these fields to Settings)
    - Embeds exp claim; default TTL should be configurable (e.g. ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    - expires_delta_seconds=-1 must produce an already-expired token (for test_token_expires)

  decode_access_token(token: str) -> dict
    - Verifies signature and expiry; raises jose.ExpiredSignatureError or jose.JWTError on failure
    - Returns the decoded payload dict

Settings additions (app/core/config.py):
  SECRET_KEY: str = 'dev-secret-key'  (override in production via env)
  ALGORITHM: str = 'HS256'
  ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 30

Also add app/core/security.py (or inline in auth.py) with a get_current_user FastAPI dependency that:
  - Reads Bearer token from Authorization header
  - Decodes it and returns the user payload dict
  - Raises 401 on missing/invalid token

Verify: ENV=testing pytest tests/unit/test_auth_utils.py --no-cov should pass all 8 tests.

title: Implement GET /api/v1/patients/{patient_id} endpoint
description:
Create app/api/api_v1/endpoints/patients.py and register in api.py.

Route: GET /patients/{patient_id}
Path param: patient_id: int (FastAPI validates type; string → 422 automatically)
Auth: Bearer JWT, PCP role only
Validation: patient_id must be > 0 → 422 for negative values (use Annotated[int, Path(gt=0)])

Behaviour:
1. Look up Patient by patient_id → 404 if not found
2. Verify patient.primary_physician_id == current_user.user_id → 403
3. Load associated ClinicalImage rows (eager or separate query)
4. Insert AuditLog(user_id, action='VIEW_PATIENT', target_resource=f'patient:{patient_id}')
5. Return 200 PatientResponse

Create app/schemas/patient.py:
  ClinicalImageSummary(query_id, gcs_uri, captured_at, lesion_location)
  PatientResponse(patient_id, mrn_internal, date_of_birth, gender, clinical_images: list[ClinicalImageSummary])

Register: api_router.include_router(patients.router, prefix='/patients', tags=['patients'])

Tests that must go green: tests/integration/test_patients.py (all 11 tests).

HIPAA note: the audit log test verifies str(patient_id) appears in target_resource.

title: Implement POST /api/v1/feedback endpoint
description:
Create app/api/api_v1/endpoints/feedback.py and register in api.py.

Route: POST /feedback
Auth: Bearer JWT, PCP role only
Request body: { query_id: str, reference_id: str, is_helpful: bool }

Behaviour:
1. Look up ClinicalImage by query_id → 404
2. Look up ReferenceAtlas by reference_id → 404
3. Verify image.user_id == current_user.user_id → 403
4. Upsert RecommendationFeedback on (query_id, reference_id, user_id):
   - If record exists, update is_helpful
   - If new, insert
   - Return 201 on insert, 200 on update (or 201 for both — see test_feedback_duplicate_updates_existing_record which accepts 200 or 201 on second call)
5. Insert AuditLog(user_id, action='FEEDBACK', target_resource=str(query_id))

Note on upsert: SQLite does not support ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE the same way Postgres does.
Use a select-then-insert-or-update pattern for SQLite/Postgres compat in tests.

Register: api_router.include_router(feedback.router, prefix='/feedback', tags=['feedback'])

Tests that must go green: tests/integration/test_feedback.py (all 11 tests).

title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/token endpoint
description:
Create app/api/api_v1/endpoints/auth.py and register it in app/api/api_v1/api.py.

Route: POST /auth/token
Request body: OAuth2 application/x-www-form-urlencoded with fields username (email) and password
Response: TokenResponse { access_token: str, token_type: 'bearer' }

Behaviour:
- Look up User by email (case-insensitive is fine)
- verify_password(plain, user.password_hash) — return 401 on mismatch or unknown user
- create_access_token({'sub': str(user.user_id), 'role': user.role.value})
- Return 200 TokenResponse
- Never reveal whether the email exists (same 401 for both wrong password and unknown email)

Also create app/schemas/auth.py:
  TokenResponse(access_token: str, token_type: str = 'bearer')

Register router in api.py:
  api_router.include_router(auth.router, prefix='/auth', tags=['auth'])

Tests that must go green (tests/integration/test_auth.py — all 11 tests).

title: Implement POST /api/v1/upload/image endpoint
description:
Create app/api/api_v1/endpoints/upload.py and register in api.py.

Route: POST /upload/image
Auth: Bearer JWT, PCP role only (403 for PATIENT, 401 for missing token)
Request: multipart/form-data
  - file: UploadFile (image/jpeg or image/png)
  - patient_id: int (required, Form field)
  - lesion_location: str (required)
  - clinician_notes: str (optional)

Behaviour:
1. Validate file content-type is image/jpeg or image/png → 400 otherwise
2. Validate file is not empty → 400
3. Validate file size <= 10 MB → 413
4. Verify patient exists → 404
5. Verify patient.primary_physician_id == current_user.user_id → 403
6. Upload file to GCS using google.cloud.storage.Client:
   bucket.blob(f'images/{uuid4()}.jpg').upload_from_file(...)
   On GCS exception → 503
7. Insert ClinicalImage row with gcs_image_uri, lesion_location, clinician_notes, user_id, patient_id
8. Return 201 { query_id: str }

Also create app/schemas/upload.py:
  UploadRequest — for any JSON body needs (patient_id required, lesion_location required)
  UploadResponse(query_id: str)

Register: api_router.include_router(upload.router, prefix='/upload', tags=['upload'])

Tests that must go green: tests/integration/test_upload.py (all 13 tests).

title: Implement POST /api/v1/lesion/analyze endpoint
description:
Create app/api/api_v1/endpoints/lesion.py and register in api.py.

Route: POST /lesion/analyze
Auth: Bearer JWT, PCP role only
Request body: { query_id: str (UUID) }

Behaviour:
1. Look up ClinicalImage by query_id → 404 if not found
2. Verify image.user_id == current_user.user_id → 403
3. Call Vertex AI MatchingEngineIndexEndpoint.find_neighbors(deployed_index_id=..., queries=[[...]], num_neighbors=10)
   On exception → 503
4. For each returned neighbour, look up ReferenceAtlas by reference_id
5. Return 200 { results: list of { reference_id, diagnosis_label, score, gcs_uri } }, capped at 10
6. Empty neighbour list → 200 { results: [] }
7. Insert AuditLog(user_id, action='ANALYZE', target_resource=str(query_id))

VERTEX_AI_INDEX_ENDPOINT setting already exists in config; add VERTEX_AI_DEPLOYED_INDEX_ID if needed.

Also update app/schemas/ with AnalyzeRequest and AnalyzeResponse models as needed.

Register: api_router.include_router(lesion.router, prefix='/lesion', tags=['lesion'])

Tests that must go green: tests/integration/test_analyze.py (all 10 tests).
